Noel Chen: hi all, noel here starting today as a product designer on Growth. quick Qs: laptop status is 'label printed' how long does shipping usually take? who should i ping for access to design assets and Figma org? fun fact: i make papier-me2che9 miniatures of famous buildings. :city_sunrise:

Aisha Malik: welcome noel!! i'm your onboarding buddy. i'll DM a 30m walkthrough and add you to the design Figma team. for laptop shipping ping it-helpdesk and cc eng-infra-bot. :tada:
it-helpdesk: Ticket IT-5501 created for Noel Chen: Temporary dev VM provisioned. SSH details and keys are in 1Password -> "IT Temp Keys". Laptop status updated to "in transit".
Noel Chen: thanks! temporary VM worked. any recommended reading for our Growth design patterns or design tokens?

Aisha Malik: start with /design/growth-patterns and the design-tokens README. i'll drop links in the DM. weekly design critique is Thu 9am PT, super casual.

eng-infra-bot: Added Noel Chen to org "redwood-inference" and teams: design-growth, product-design. Please accept the GitHub invite sent to your email.

Nora (People Ops): welcome noel! virtual welcome coffee at 11am PT tomorrow if you'd like to share a pic of a papier-me2che9 model. also ping me for swag size.

Noel Chen: i'll bring a mini Eiffel Tower to the coffee :flag-fr: and will accept invites. excited to be here!
